findings: The only exact origin and audit history are temporary, while R5 deliberately excludes that old audit history from the projected restore closure.
The proposed external cutover broadens the recorded transition authority beyond its exact write set.
Restore-only enforcement relies on a search snapshot that is not bound into C0, K or E and was already stale relative to the current durable repository HEAD.
Crash recovery relies on operation manifests whose exact schema, identity and publication topology are unspecified.
Excluded private metadata can still reveal paths, object IDs, hashes and sizes.
R5 hashes a non-durable root; loss of the temporary repositories removes the only verified source object and design bytes.
Custom refs, raw objects and additional namespaces do not create an independent trust or failure domain under the same local write capability.
The proof surface is disproportionate to the current personal single-machine threat model.
Custom refs make ordinary clone and recovery less reliable.
Source provenance, backup, runtime genesis, admission and activation are unnecessarily coupled.

root_adjudication.why: The current objective is tamper-evident and recoverable paper-only audit history for one person on one machine. R5 adds custom refs, raw-object construction, a second object format and multiple state machines without adding a genuinely independent retained authority or failure domain.

next_design_candidate.name: STANDARD_GIT_AUDIT_BASELINE_V1
required_properties: Use an exact standard Git source commit and tree located in a durable repository.
Use ordinary branches and tags; do not introduce custom refs, hand-built raw Git objects, a new Git object format or a custom genesis protocol.
Bind only project identity, source commit and tree, ledger tail and count, an excluded/private-artifact manifest, and a backup-set identity.
Define a fresh-clone restore test plus restoration of separately retained private or ignored artifacts.
Predeclare corruption, rollback, missing-tag, stale-backup, missing-private-artifact and ledger-rewrite negative cases.
State that guarantees are tamper-evident relative to an independently retained copy, not immutable against the same administrator capability.
If whole-vault privacy is shown to block the ordinary durable repository route, compare a project-only repository using ordinary Git before adding custom object machinery.
